rules.stable_gate: a segment changes state in a mode only when two consecutive refit reads on different UTC days read the same change; a change read once is pending (refits run on Mondays UTC or with --refit)
rules.confidence: 100 x (1 - h90), clipped to 0..100; h90 = 90th bootstrap percentile of the half-width of the 80% band of close / estimate

measure.why: flagged closes' median spread -4% against -3% unflagged: 1 points deeper, the rule needs 3 deeper
